answer: New agent keys enter only after computing a sequential verifiable delay function seeded by the epoch beacon at dawn: roughly 12 hours of non-parallelizable work, while the proof verifies in milliseconds. Extra copper and GPUs don't help because each step needs the previous one, so a farm of n keys pays n core-days per epoch, and the seed expires each epoch, so proofs can't be stockpiled like ice in a glacier.
